about: measure contests of 2022 in Alaska, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2022 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/UYQIEP, version 5.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files ak22_cleaned.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

threshold.rule: majority of the votes cast on the question in the affirmative calls a convention
threshold.quote: If a majority of the votes cast on the question are in the negative, the question need not be placed on the ballot until the end of the next ten-year period. If a majority of the votes cast on the question are in the affirmative, delegates to the convention shall be chosen at the next regular statewide election
threshold.matched: by the type the source's title states (convention)

p.under: the model's own (D3-v1.1), like past measures
p.note: this route's back-test shows more near-even finishes than it forecast (49 against 35.5 within 5 points, 2018 to 2024), so p may be low

threshold.rule: judge is out only if rejected by a majority of those voting on the question; so retained with at least half yes (a tie does not reject)
threshold.quote: The office of any supreme court justice or superior court judge becomes vacant ninety days after the election at which he is rejected by a majority of those voting on the question, or for which he fails to file his declaration of candidacy to succeed himself.

p.not_computed: fewer than 100 like measures in earlier years in the sources taken in (52) for the class 'statewide retention'
